name: Structure of English Language
description: The course combines knowledge of language structures with their hands-on application to improving language skills. Students will be introduced to simple techniques used for linguistic analysis to help them decode the often unspoken rules of spoken (and written) language. It will provide students with opportunities to speak, perform, and engage with real-world materials. Activities will include reading aloud activities (individual and group), dramatic monologues, declamation, acting out scenes from plays and movies, speeches, and role-playing. The course will also introduce various cultural texts—books, films, poems, songs, speeches, plays—as models of language use.
